events.title: We made Dead Block for XBLA in 2011. Here’s why we decided to return to it.
events.summary: The whole journey started back in 2005. I was completely obsessed with that classic zombie movie trope: a ragtag group of people barricaded inside a house, desperately trying to survive against an endless horde outside. I built a super rough prototype back then—literally just a guy blocking windows and scavenging for random junk—but even in its crudest form, the core fun was already there.A few screenshots from the earliest prototype of Dead Block that was created 2005Fast forward to 2009. events.title: Check out the Updated Dead Party Demo in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone,We are excited to announce that Dead Party is participating in Next Fest, with an updated demo! Along with the original 4 levels already in the demo, we added the Museum, a Fuel Run level that will test your ability to work together. You can unlock the Museum level by completing all the other levels in the demo, and if you have already done so this level will already be unlocked! events.title: We're Back, the Zombies are too...
events.summary: Hello everyone,Some of you might remember a little game called Dead Block, a zombie barricading, rock-n-roll fueled romp that hit consoles way back in 2011. Well, the team behind it never stopped loving that music-forward mayhem. Fast forward to today, we're thrilled to officially say hello from our new home here on Steam: Dead Party is real, it's coming, and it's everything we wished Dead Block could have been back then and then some.For the Dead Block fans out there, this one's for you.
